# Motion card morph

The motion-card-morph recipe: one shape never cuts. A dot springs into a headline pill, the pill opens into a card whose rows land on a stagger, then folds into a control the cursor clicks.

- Type: Motion card morph
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `motion`
- Output: 1920x1080, 6 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/s14-motion-card-morph.mp4`](../videos/s14-motion-card-morph.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 6 second 16:9 clip for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the motion-card-morph style only: a pill titled "What Magnifito does" opens into a card with four rows (websites, social media, email and ads, automation), then becomes a control the cursor clicks. Use the motion engine. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s14-motion-card-morph
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s14-motion-card-morph/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --format 16:9 --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
